def sq(f):
    L=f.ascii.split('\n')
    return [ ''.join(L[r][c] for c in range(27,37)) for r in range(34,44) ]
def brush(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('p','W'):
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            if 15<=min(rs) and n['pixels']>=40:
                return f"{n['color']} r{min(rs)}-{max(rs)} c{min(cs)}-{max(cs)}"
    return None
print("before:", brush(current_frame))

print("after LEFT:", brush(current_frame))

r=action(['SPACE'])
print("after white top paint:")
for i,row in enumerate(sq(current_frame)): print(34+i, row)
print("result:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ['board_changed','level_completed','done']})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
